name: Survey tile in Scorpius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Scorpius, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 6 visits over 47 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 15 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 47 hours starting 2025-08-14, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 1.60 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
